citation: Keung, P., Lu, Y., Szarvas, G., & Smith, N. A. (2020). The Multilingual Amazon Reviews Corpus. In Proceedings of EMNLP 2020.
license: Amazon Academic License (Free for academic and research evaluation)
missing_value_policy: Drop rows where review_text or sentiment_label is missing/empty
duplicate_policy: Deduplicate on exact (review_text, language) match, retaining first occurrence
known_biases: Product domain vocabulary skew towards electronics and household consumer goods
Higher proportion of 5-star positive reviews compared to neutral 3-star reviews
Cultural differences in review length and phrasing across languages (e.g. Japanese reviews tend to be more polite and concise)
